instrument_name: Alaska DOLWD Wage and Hour Pamphlet 100 (October 2025): AS 23.05, AS 23.10 (Alaska Wage and Hour Act incl. 2024 Ballot Measure 1), 8 AAC 15 (incl. sick-leave regs eff. 2025-09-25)
authority: Alaska DOLWD Labor Standards and Safety Division
figure_or_rule_carried: Min wage 13.00 from 2025-07-01, 14.00 from 2026-07-01, 15.00 from 2027-07-01, then CPI-U Anchorage indexation calculated each 30 Sep for prior calendar year, rounded UP to nearest 0.10, applies 1 Jan-31 Dec (from 2028-01-01 by the text); floor = federal min + 2.00 (indexed); no tip credit (23.10.065). Daily OT 1.5x over 8 h/day and weekly over 40 h (daily OT hours excluded from weekly count); exempt if employer <4 employees, voluntary flex plan 10h/40h certified by DOLWD, etc. (23.10.060). EAP exemption needs salary >= 2x state min wage x 40 h/week (23.10.055(b)); exempt daily-rate option >= 300 USD/day (8 AAC 15.908). Paid sick leave from 2025-07-01: 1 h per 30 h; cap 56 h/yr (15+ employees) or 40 h/yr (<15); exempt employees assumed 40 h/wk; carry-over (use capped); no payout on separation (23.10.068(a)(1)); reinstate if rehired within 6 months; FTE count prior calendar year (8 AAC 15.106); front-loading allowed (15.108); paid at regular rate or min wage, whichever greater (15.111). Pay periods monthly or semi-monthly at employee's election (monthly by annual initial contract) (23.05.140(a)). Final pay: employer termination within 3 working days; employee quit next regular payday at least 3 days after notice; penalty up to 90 working days (23.05.140(b),(d)). Written notice at hire of payday, place, rate (23.05.160). Wages in money or negotiable check payable in-state (23.10.040); direct deposit only if voluntarily authorised, bank of employee's choice (23.10.043). Pay statement each pay period, written or electronic: rate, gross, net, period dates, FIT, FICA, AK ESA contributions, board/lodging, advances, straight-time and OT hours, other deductions, sick leave used in accrual year, sick leave balance (8 AAC 15.160(h) as am. 2025-09-25). Records 3 years (23.10.100). Deductions only by written agreement, not below min wage/OT, no shortages/breakage unless admitted in writing (8 AAC 15.160(a)-(g)).

instrument_name: Alaska Employment Security Tax Employer Handbook (taxbook.pdf, PDF modified 2025-05-05)
article_or_section: pp. 6-25 (employer, multistate, TQ01, wage base, employee contribution, records, excluded employment, wages, retirement/125/fringe, rates)
figure_or_rule_carried: Quarterly Contribution Report TQ01 + wage schedule due last day of month after quarter (Apr 30, Jul 31, Oct 31, Jan 31); within 10 days of ceasing business; zero report required; min 10 USD late-filing penalty; online filing mandatory if 50+ employees on wage schedule, 1M+ taxable wages in current/prior year, or payroll agent files. Wage base = 75% of Alaska average annual wage, recalculated yearly; wages reported in quarter PAID; transfer to AK within same company: credit for other-state taxable wages in same calendar year; successor may combine predecessor wages. Employer deducts employee share and remits with TQ01; annual employee statement of contributions withheld (W-2 generally). Payroll records 5 years incl. SSN, wages, hours, hire/termination dates and cause. Excluded: sole props/partners/LLC members; corporate executive officers (elective, all as group); ministers/religious orders, church service; enrolled students at school; agricultural <20,000/qtr or <10 workers; fishing crews <10 on share basis; domestic <1,000/qtr; newspaper carriers; elected/appointed officials; commission insurance/real estate/stock sales; work-study under 22; tribal officers; 501(a) org <250/qtr; family employment of sole prop. UI wages exclude employer and employee deferrals to 401(k)/403(b)/457/SIMPLE/SEP/employer IRA/Roth 401(k); cafeteria-plan exclusions limited to group-term life, accident/health, 401(k), disability, FSA, HSA; dependent care, adoption assistance, group legal and cash under 125 ARE UI wages; non-required severance, moving reimbursement, per diem, room and board for employer convenience excluded; tips reported to employer, sick and vacation pay included. Notice to Employees placard must be posted. Multistate: USDOL localization guidelines.

authority: Alaska DOLWD Labor Standards and Safety Division

No 2026 statutory amendment mentioned.

instrument_name: AS 45.48 Alaska Personal Information Protection Act (breach notice AS 45.48.010-.090; SSN use AS 45.48.400-.480), wayback snapshot 2026-10-11
figure_or_rule_carried: SSN: may not intentionally make an SSN available to the general public; may not print SSN on material mailed to the individual unless law authorises it or it is an application/enrolment/account form (never on a postcard or visible through an envelope window); no SSN over the Internet unless secure/encrypted (45.48.400). Collection and disclosure prohibited except, inter alia, where authorised by law or for the individual's employment, including employment benefits (45.48.410(b)(5), 45.48.430(b)(6)); exception for employees, agents and contractors (45.48.450). Breach of security involving personal information: disclose to each Alaska resident without unreasonable delay; no-harm determination requires written notice to the attorney general and 5-year documentation (45.48.010). No pay-statement SSN truncation rule in Alaska law located: 8 AAC 15.160(h) does not require the SSN on the statement; mailed pay statements must not show the full SSN (45.48.400(a)(5) reading). Direct host unreachable; read from web.archive.org snapshot 20261011135104.
